purpose: Keep generated Level 1/2 macro landforms compatible with the fully mapped LPC cliff shape lane by removing one-cell rasterization posts and notches before cliff masks, rendering, and collision are derived.

rules.removeGeneratedTerminal: For a threshold mask, a raised generated cell with <=1 same-threshold cardinal neighbor is lowered one structural tier.
rules.fillGeneratedNotch: For a threshold mask, a lower generated cell with >=3 same-threshold cardinal neighbors is raised to that threshold.
rules.preserveDiagonal: Any generated cell with >=2 same-threshold cardinal supports is preserved; normal 45-degree stair-step contours therefore remain available to the ElizaWy rounded/diagonal recipes.
rules.protectedCells: Protected civic/road cells remain Level 0 and are never raised by contour cleanup.
rules.editorAuthoredLevels: Not modified. This pass only normalizes the fresh PCG macro-landform mask before it is written into SceneMap structural_levels.

acceptance: two-neighbor diagonal staircase boundary is preserved
Level 2 terminal falls back to Level 1
